# Introduction

This document discusses basic risk model concepts used across the desk.

## Volatility

Volatility $\sigma$ measures the dispersion of returns.

$$
\sigma^2 = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} (r_i - \bar{r})^2
$$ (1)

The equation above defines the sample variance, from which volatility is derived by taking
the square root.
